---
title: "Reward Gradient Explorer"
subtitle: "How much is each consecutive strike worth?"
---

Use the slider to set the number of consecutive strikes from frame 1. All remaining frames are filled with your chosen open frame. Both scores update live.

```{ojs}
//| echo: false

function scoreTraditional(balls) {
  let score = 0, i = 0;
  for (let frame = 0; frame < 10; frame++) {
    if (i >= balls.length) return null;
    if (frame < 9) {
      if (balls[i] === 10) {
        if (i + 2 >= balls.length) return null;
        score += 10 + balls[i+1] + balls[i+2];
        i += 1;
      } else {
        if (i + 1 >= balls.length) return null;
        score += balls[i] + balls[i+1];
        if (balls[i] + balls[i+1] === 10) {
          if (i + 2 >= balls.length) return null;
          score += balls[i+2];
        }
        i += 2;
      }
    } else {
      if (balls[i] === 10) {
        if (i + 2 >= balls.length) return null;
        score += 10 + balls[i+1] + balls[i+2];
      } else {
        if (i + 1 >= balls.length) return null;
        if (balls[i] + balls[i+1] === 10) {
          if (i + 2 >= balls.length) return null;
          score += 10 + balls[i+2];
        } else {
          score += balls[i] + balls[i+1];
        }
      }
    }
  }
  return score;
}

function scoreWorld(balls) {
  let score = 0, i = 0;
  for (let frame = 0; frame < 10; frame++) {
    if (i >= balls.length) return null;
    if (balls[i] === 10) {
      score += 30; i += 1;
    } else {
      if (i + 1 >= balls.length) return null;
      if (balls[i] + balls[i+1] === 10) score += 10 + balls[i];
      else score += balls[i] + balls[i+1];
      i += 2;
    }
  }
  return score;
}
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
viewof nStrikes = Inputs.range([0, 10], {value: 5, step: 1, label: "Consecutive strikes (frames 1–N)"})
viewof fillType = Inputs.select(["5,4 (mid)", "3,2 (weak)", "8,1 (strong)", "7,2 (mid-high)"], {label: "Non-strike fill", value: "5,4 (mid)"})
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false

fillBalls = {
  const map = {"5,4 (mid)": [5,4], "3,2 (weak)": [3,2], "8,1 (strong)": [8,1], "7,2 (mid-high)": [7,2]};
  return map[fillType];
}

gradientData = {
  let rows = [];
  for (let n = 0; n <= 10; n++) {
    let balls = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) balls.push(10);
    let remaining = 10 - n;
    for (let i = 0; i < remaining; i++) balls = balls.concat(fillBalls);
    if (n === 10) {
      balls = [10,10,10,10,10,10,10,10,10,10,10,10];
    } else if (n === 9) {
      balls.pop(); balls.pop();
      balls.push(10);
      balls = balls.concat(fillBalls);
    }
    let t = scoreTraditional(balls);
    let w = scoreWorld(balls);
    let tm = n > 0 ? t - rows[n-1].trad : 0;
    let wm = n > 0 ? w - rows[n-1].world : 0;
    rows.push({strikes: n, trad: t, world: w, tradMarginal: tm, worldMarginal: wm, current: n === nStrikes});
  }
  return rows;
}

currentRow = gradientData[nStrikes]
```

### Full table

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
Inputs.table(gradientData, {
  columns: ["strikes", "trad", "world", "tradMarginal", "worldMarginal"],
  header: {
    strikes: "Consecutive Strikes",
    trad: "Traditional Score",
    world: "World Bowling Score",
    tradMarginal: "Trad. Marginal",
    worldMarginal: "WB Marginal"
  },
  format: {
    tradMarginal: d => d > 0 ? `+${d}` : d === 0 ? "—" : d,
    worldMarginal: d => d > 0 ? `+${d}` : d === 0 ? "—" : d,
  }
})
```

## What to notice

- **Traditional marginal value increases** as the run extends — the 10th strike is worth far more than the 1st
- **World Bowling marginal is flat** — every strike adds the same amount regardless of context
- Change the fill type to see that this pattern holds regardless of what the non-strike frames score
- The compounding effect is a structural property of the bonus system, not an artefact of any particular example
